name: Cushman Eagle / Highlander / Pacemaker
engine: Cushman Husky air-cooled side-valve single, one carb, two-speed on many
intro: The American scooters with the Husky flathead engine. Simple, rugged and well supported by the Cushman club.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
